subject: Computer Science

questions.q: Who is generally regarded as the 'Father of the Computer'?
questions.explain: Charles Babbage designed the Analytical Engine, the first mechanical computer concept, earning him the title.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: The first generation of computers used which technology?
questions.explain: First generation computers (e.g., ENIAC) used Vacuum Tubes. 2nd: Transistors, 3rd: ICs, 4th: Microprocessors.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.explain: 1 Byte = 8 Bits. 4 Bits is typically called a Nibble.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: The process of starting a computer is known as:
questions.explain: Booting is the initialization sequence of the computer OS.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: Which of the following is considered 'Soft Copy'?
questions.explain: Soft copy refers to a digital version of a document viewed on a screen, unlike hard copy which is printed on paper.
questions.subject: Computer Science

questions.q: Which generation of computers used Integrated Circuits (ICs)?
questions.explain: 3rd Generation used ICs. 1st: Vacuum tubes, 2nd: Transistors, 4th: VLSI/Microprocessors.
questions.subject: Computer Science
